description: Markers the access classifier (v1-e04-t03) reads in a fetched page. A challenge marker makes the page BLOCKED, a paywall marker makes it PAYWALLED; challenge markers are tried first, and within a list the first marker that matches is the one recorded. schema.org isAccessibleForFree is not here: the HTML extractor (v1-e04-t04) reads it and refuses the page, and the classifier maps that refusal. Any change to this file is a new version: a new file name, version and pinned hash (debate_core/tests/retrieval/test_access.py).
